name: Dolor
backstory:
__NOTOC__

Dolor is a serial killer seeking to gain the Bhaalist title of Unholy Assassin by impressing the Murder Tribunal. He is the son of Ffion Goldgrind, who was a sex worker at Sharess' Caress before being murdered by Dolor. He is first encountered under the false name Master Meztli.
voice_hint: dwarf rogue (voiced by Mark Takeshi Ota)
